column1: # tests/fixtures/naming_episodes.tsv -- upstream's own episode naming tests, translated.
# Every row is one case from Jellyfin 12.1's naming test suite
# (tests/Jellyfin.Naming.Tests/TV/*.cs at ee91c75e77), cited by file and
# line in the first column. The titles are replaced by names from the
# invented cast (docs/CONVENTIONS.md) -- the upstream suite names real shows --
# keeping every character the expressions care about: digits, separators,
# brackets, the letters x, e, s and p, and where each sits. Release tags that
# only decorate the name are shortened where the privacy gate would read them
# as a real release; the ones that matter to an expression are kept.
#   source    upstream test file and line
#   flags     directory (parse as a folder), absolute (absolute display
#             windows (the harness writes the path with backslashes behind
#             a drive letter, as upstream's second block does)
#   season, episode, end, series, date: what upstream asserts. "*" is a
#             field that upstream's test does not assert; an empty cell is an
#             asserted "no value"; episode "unresolved" means the resolver
#             returns nothing at all, "stub" that it returns a placeholder.
